scope: governed AI-chat attachment admission, quarantine, content addressing, and untrusted evidence projection
invariants: raw attachment bytes terminate at the attachment admission boundary
byte signatures rather than filename or claimed MIME determine supported format
claimed MIME or filename extension disagreement fails closed
file and batch budgets are enforced before extraction or model exposure
admitted attachments are content addressed by sha256
attachment extracted text is always projected as untrusted evidence
multimodal ingestion requires matching digest size media type and format
attachment admission grants no tool or execution authority
promotion_rule: implemented candidate only; exact-head regression and independent verification must pass before qualification
